_comment: Cryptarithm locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the assignment token `[A 5]`, single letters, or digits.

_slots.{letter}: A puzzle letter, e.g. S or E
_slots.{used_letter}: The letter that already claimed a digit
_slots.{assigned}: How many letters are mapped so far
_slots.{pct}: Progress as a percentage string, e.g. 50%

player_prompt.intro:
Kɛlɛ kɔnɔfɛnɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔfɛnɛ ŋana wɔɔrɔdɔɔrɔ la.
Kɛlɛ `[A 5]` la, ɲɛfɔɲɛ kɛlɛ wɔɔrɔ.

invalid_move.letter_not_in_puzzle: Kɛlɛ {letter} tɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔfɛnɛ ŋana wɔɔrɔdɔɔrɔ la.
invalid_move.digit_used: Jatiden {digit} be sɔrɔ ka ban tuma min na, o ye: {used_letter}.
invalid_move.leading_zero: Kumaden ɲɛgɛn man kan ka kɛ 0 ye.

outcome.correct: Tiɲɛn na, o ye fɛɛrɛ ɲuman lo ye.
outcome.incorrect: A be komi a tun ma foyi ye. Nka, o tɛ tiɲɛn ye hali dɔɔni!
outcome.limit: An sera ka se yɔrɔ minw na, an be taga yen.
